fields.assessment_notes: Krazy Nick's Games now reads as a close, broad Magic store rather than merely a Wednesday/Sunday Commander option. Fresh Wizards/EventLink on 2026-07-23 supports Wednesday/Sunday Commander, Thursday Modern, Friday Pauper, Standard Showdown, Hobbit prerelease, and future Reality Fracture prerelease sealed events. Official site evidence supports current physical operation, MTG inventory, event-entry products, buylist/store-credit activity, hours, phone, and Cerritos address. Public Instagram route is captured, but post-level content replay remains TBD. Prior inspected Discord evidence supports some real Commander pod/turnout texture, while the latest mapped schedule-channel read was stale/quiet. Yelp-derived review texture remains mixed. Honey Pot evidence is separated and not used for Krazy conclusions.

fields.assessment_notes: ProjectCCG - Santa Ana / OC remains a strong nearby Magic planning candidate, with branch-safe Wizards/EventLink support refreshed on 2026-07-23 for OC Commander, Draft, and Standard Showdown rows already represented in the app. General ProjectCCG website and Instagram evidence supports the broader ProjectCCG brand/source route, but is not used alone for Santa Ana event truth. Existing ProjectCCG Discord evidence remains material for OC operational reliability, cancellations/reopening notes, and community routing, but this batch did not run a new Discord survey. Keep Santa Ana / OC facts separate from Alhambra/plain ProjectCCG unless a source proves the relationship.

operations.reason: Refresh branch-aware ProjectCCG Santa Ana assessment notes and make the multi-branch Instagram route visible with caveats.

fields.assessment_notes: TK Collectibles remains a real Newport Beach TCG shop and a low-priority but valid Saturday Commander backup. Fresh Wizards/EventLink on 2026-07-23 shows only a Saturday noon Casual Commander row in the checked future window; the prior Sunday July 19 row should be treated as a past dated one-off, not an emerging Sunday routine. Official site remains generic/low-detail, while public Instagram route evidence is now visible but post-level MTG content replay remains TBD. Existing review and non-MTG organized-play evidence supports physical operation and event-hosting capability, but Magic community depth, turnout, proxy norms, and solo-arrival fit remain unresolved.

fields.assessment_notes: Games For Meeple remains a credible Diamond Bar multi-TCG candidate with fresh 2026-07-23 Wizards/EventLink support for the existing Friday Night Magic Commander Night and Sunday Casual Play Commander Fun rows. No draft, prerelease/sealed, or special MTG rows appeared in the checked WPN window. The official website currently resolves to a password/login page, making it less useful as a planning surface until reopened or verified through another route. Public Instagram and Facebook routes support store identity and MTG category presence, but post-level content replay remains TBD. Existing review/resource mirrors still support active store/play texture with one service/culture caution.
